tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Put a product in the basket at Bearded Colonel. Changes the basket; it does not take payment or place an order, and anything added can be removed again. Subscription products need the delivery frequency in `option` - call get_product_details first to see what they are, and if it is missing this returns the choices instead of guessing. Returns { text, added, needs_option, options[], name, quantity, items, total, cart_url }.

product.description: The product name, or part of it. Ignored when `id` is given.

id.description: The product ID from an earlier answer. Exact, and never ambiguous - prefer it over a name when you have one.

option.description: For a subscription product, the delivery frequency, for example "Every 2 months".

tools.name: apply_coupon
tools.description: Apply a discount code to the basket at Bearded Colonel. A code that is invalid, expired or not valid for what is in the basket fails harmlessly and says why. Changes the basket; it does not take payment. Returns { text, applied, code, discount, total }.

code.description: The discount code, exactly as the customer received it.

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Everything about ONE product at Bearded Colonel, looked up by name: price, subscription frequencies, stock, category. This is the tool to use whenever a product name is known, including a partial one. Read-only. Some products carry no written description, so follow the link for the full page. Returns { text, found, ambiguous, alternatives[], id, sku, name, price, in_stock, categories[], options[], url } - when several products match, one is chosen and the rest are named in alternatives.

name.description: The product name, or part of it. Ignored when `id` is given.

id.description: The product ID from an earlier answer. Exact, and never ambiguous - prefer it over a name when you have one.

tools.name: get_site_overview
tools.description: What Bearded Colonel is, and the main sections of the site. Read-only. Use it first to see what the site covers. Returns { text, name, tagline, sections[] } where each section has title and url.

tools.name: get_subscription_terms
tools.description: How subscriptions work at Bearded Colonel: commitment, changing delivery frequency, pausing and cancelling. Read-only. Returns { text, contract, can_change_date, can_pause, can_cancel, self_service, manage_url } as booleans plus the account URL.

tools.name: go_to_checkout
tools.description: Take the visitor to the checkout page at Bearded Colonel with the basket as it stands. This moves the browser to the checkout; it fills nothing in, pays for nothing and orders nothing - the person completes it themselves. Returns { text, ready, count, total, navigate }.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The product categories at Bearded Colonel. Read-only. Returns { text, categories[] } where each category has id, slug, name, products count and url.

tools.name: list_delivery_options
tools.description: Where Bearded Colonel delivers and what postage costs. Postage is charged by item type and is free above an order threshold, so this returns both. Read-only. The figure for a particular basket is confirmed at checkout. Returns { text, zones[] } where each zone has zone, free_over and postage[] of item type and cost including VAT.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search the pages and articles on Bearded Colonel. Read-only. Returns { text, results[] } where each result has title, extract and url.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Browse or search what Bearded Colonel sells when the product is not known by name: a keyword, a category, or a need like "dry skin". Returns a shortlist. For one named product, call get_product_details instead. Read-only. Returns { text, products[] } where each product has id, sku, name, price, in_stock and url - hold the id and use it for the next call.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words.

tools.name: update_cart_item
tools.description: Change how many of a line already in the basket, or remove it by setting quantity to 0. Changes the basket; it does not take payment. Returns { text, updated, name, quantity, count, total }.

product.description: The name of a line already in the basket, or part of it. Ignored when `id` is given.

id.description: The product ID of a line in the basket, as view_cart reports it.

quantity.description: The new quantity. 0 removes the line.

tools.name: view_cart
tools.description: What is in the basket at Bearded Colonel right now, line by line, with the total and any discount applied. Read-only. Returns { text, empty, items[], count, total, cart_url } where each item has id, name, quantity and subtotal - the id is what update_cart_item wants.
